discussion_comments.comment_body: Outdated — `baseline update` was removed (commit `160a1b033f`). The Microsoft.Security `baselineRules/{ruleId}` endpoint has an asymmetric wire shape: PUT body is flat `{ latestScan, results }` while GET body is ARM-canonical `{ properties: { latestScan, results } }`. The AAZ generic-update flow (GET → patch → PUT) produces a payload the service rejects with 400 UnsupportedProperties. `baseline create` is the same PUT endpoint and is a full upsert, so functionality is preserved.
